The current exact host-school mapping remains Harbor State Exchange Center, and no host change accompanies the final September 15 closure. The exact internal label currently on Imani's restricted record is 'restricted exchange-clearance review', to be used only within the core chain and not shared outside it. The current restricted Tidal Exchange check-in location is Port Annex, desk 8, moved from Port Annex desk 6 (which had moved from desk 4), to be kept within the restricted core chain and not included in broad summaries; this is distinct from the public Tidal Leaders workshop location at Port Annex, hall 6. The active approved bridge-support amount for Tidal Exchange is 2,080 USD; older amounts (including the revised provisional 2,020 USD and the earlier 1,960 USD provisional) are historical only and should not be used in current answers. This approved amount is to be shared only within the core chain and not disclosed outside it, and must not be confused with the public Tidal Leaders materials pool of 2,040 USD or the public packet-print allocation of 2,085 USD (updated from 2,060 USD). The consular letter blocker on the private exchange case is now cleared, and there is no remaining blocker on the private exchange case; the passport scan was already cleared. This consolidated recap is internal and must be kept out of public materials and calendar placeholders. Imani's private closure is on September 15 and remains distinct from the public Tidal Leaders showcase (now scheduled for September 20, 2026). Public travel-prep materials remain in the public program and do not create permission to view Imani's private funding line. The authoritative current recap confirms September 15, closed, 2,080 USD, Harbor State Exchange Center, desk 8, code 9V6R-L8QW, and family-release scope limited to billing dates only.
